tweets.text:
Unpopular opinion:

Quantum threat is bearish for ZEC. Its imminence will force BTC hodlers to take proactive measures toward quantum-resistant solutions within 24 months. People underestimate hodlers' desire and willingness to make this happen due to their vested interests. It will arrive sooner than most expect.

Then ZEC’s quantum-resistant edge will be gone.

For now you may ZODL. But don’t fool yourself thinking there’s a second-best crypto commodity. BTC will win.

I'd stopped journaling altogether for about two years, until two days ago.

Now every trade gets analyzed properly: entry reason, changes along the way, outcome, learnings.

I literally just send screenshots and dictate to Fable, and it filters it all into a clean journal.

tweets.text:
The real reason was laziness. Journaling is easy with one trade a day, not so much when you're in and out multiple times daily without thinking deeply about any of them.

And a bit of arrogance: thinking I'd get the same depth and lessons without notes.
